cds.title: College of Wooster Common Data Set 2025-2026 (Excel, linked from the college's Common Data Sets page)

scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 entering class): 4,568 applied, 2,941 admitted (64.4%), 341 enrolled; the residency rows (in-state 1,075/960, out-of-state 1,679/1,510, international 1,814/471) add up to the totals. International (nonresident) first-years: 1,814 applied, 471 admitted, 24 enrolled. Waitlist: 179 offered a place and 22 admitted; the CDS leaves the number accepting blank. The ED figure (173 applied, 110 admitted) covers Early Decision only; the CDS gives no count for Early Action. 20% (68 students) of enrolled first-years submitted SAT and 23% (77) ACT; Wooster is test-optional. The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column (99.7% reported a GPA). Enrollment 1,507 and nonresidents 182 are the degree-seeking undergraduate figures (B1/B2); total undergraduates are 1,515.

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs for 2026-27 from the Common Data Set G1/G5: tuition $65,510 (2.5-4.88 credit units per term), required fees $780, food and housing $16,050 (housing $7,835 + meal plan $8,215). Estimated expenses: books $1,250, transportation $250, other $1,000 (other costs shown = transportation + other). Per-credit-unit tuition $1,984. The college's international aid page gives the same 2026-27 base (tuition and fees $66,290, housing and meals $16,050) plus health insurance, books and personal fees of $4,350, for a total of $86,690. Common Data Set H6: need-based and non-need-based institutional aid is available to nonresidents; 181 degree-seeking nonresidents received it (average $43,844)
